"import cadquery as cq

L = 120.0          # plate X length
W = 80.0           # plate Y length
T = 10.0           # plate Z thickness
R = 10.0           # vertical edge fillet radius
HOLE_D = 8.0       # through-hole diameter
HX = 42.0          # hole X center offset
HY = 22.0          # hole Y center offset

part = (cq.Workplane("XY")
        .rect(L, W)
        .extrude(T)
        .edges("|Z").fillet(R)
        .faces(">Z").workplane()
        .pushPoints([(HX, HY), (HX, -HY), (-HX, HY), (-HX, -HY)])
        .circle(HOLE_D / 2.0)
        .cutThruAll())

cq.exporters.export(part.val(), "part.step")"
